entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:1
segments: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you today.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:2
segments: And it will be, on the day when you shall pass over Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall set up great stones and plaster them with plaster.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:3
segments: And you shall write on them all the words of the law when you have passed over, so that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land that flows [with] milk and honey, as the LORD God of your fathers has promised you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:4
segments: Therefore it shall be when you have gone over Jordan, you shall set up these stones which I command you today, in Mount Ebal. And you shall plaster them with plaster.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:5
segments: And you shall build an altar there to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not lift up [any] iron [tool] on them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:6
segments: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God [of] uncut stones, and you shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:7
segments: And you shall offer peace offerings, and shall eat there, and rejoice before the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:8
segments: And you shall write all the words of this law very plainly on the stones.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:9
segments: And Moses and the priests the Levites spoke to all Israel, saying: Take heed and listen, O Israel. Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:10
segments: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God, and do His commandments and His statutes which I command you today.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:11
segments: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:12
segments: These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people when you have come over Jordan: Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:13
segments: And these shall stand on Mount Ebal to curse: Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:14
segments: And the Levites shall speak and say to all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:15
segments: Cursed [is] the man that makes any graven or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and puts [it] in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:16
segments: Cursed [is] he who thinks lightly of his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:17
segments: Cursed [is] he who removes his neighbor's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:18
segments: Cursed [is] he who makes the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:19
segments: Cursed [is] he who perverts the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:20
segments: Cursed [is] he who lies with his father's wife, because he uncovers his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:21
segments: Cursed [is] he who lies with any kind of animal. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:22
segments: Cursed [is] he who lies with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:23
segments: Cursed [is] he who lies with his mother-in-law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:24
segments: Cursed [is] he who strikes his neighbor secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:25
segments: Cursed [is] he who takes reward to kill an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 27:26
segments: Cursed [is] he who does not confirm [all] the words of this law, to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
